desc:
🌟EARNS OFFLINE🌟

🍜 Cook spicy noodles by hand and grow a tiny roadside stand into a giant Noodle Empire!

💧 Pour the water, rip the packet and stir the noodles
🔥 Drain them, shake in the powder and squeeze the sauce
🌶️ Mix it all in a sizzling hot pan, then plate your bowl
⭐ Nail every step for a PERFECT bowl and bigger pay
🍲 Level up to unlock 12 recipes, all the way to Double Spicy
👥 Your Roblox friends line up as customers
👷 Hire workers and upgrade them to earn cash while you cook
🐾 Collect pets, spin the Lucky Wheel and rebirth for huge boosts
🏭 Build a factory, chili mine, farm, diner, helipad and your own Noodle Tower

💰 Join the group for a FREE +25% cash boost!
👍 Like and favorite for more noodles!
